bias.zh: 回调 · 再度守住 $165，受制于 $177

read.en: Palantir fell 2.1% on Nov 4 to $171.70, trading between $164.60 and $177.43 on heavy volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($181.2), 10-day ($189.3) and 30-day ($193.1) averages and above the rising 100-day ($163.8) and 200-day ($153.6). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 16 and is now below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 15 ($196.43), and RSI is 33.5.
read.zh: Palantir 11月4日下跌 2.1%，收于 $171.70，盘中区间 $164.60–177.43，成交量放大。股价位于下行的 5 日（$181.2）、10 日（$189.3）和 30 日均线（$193.1）下方，并高于上行的 100 日（$163.8）和 200 日均线（$153.6）。MACD 自 10月16日起位于信号线下方，现已跌至零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月15日起看空（$196.43），RSI 为 33.5。

read.en: The $164.6 low held the $163.8–165.3 support (100-day, Sep 10 and Nov 3 lows) for a second day, while the $177.43 high was rejected at the $176.5–176.8 resistance. Resistance is $176.5–177.4, then $180.8–182 (Oct 30 low, 5-day, Sep 22 low) and $184.5–187.6. Support is $163.8–165.3, then $158.3 and $152.7–153.6. A close above $177.4 would target $181–182; below $163.8, $158.

r.en: Sep 21 low; Nov 3 high $176.54; Nov 4 high $177.43
